ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 55% low-intensity (black) and 45% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central black region covering the peduncle attachment and extending to the trailing edges. Two large high-intensity white zones are located on the lateral lobes, heavily interrupted by intricate black dendritic and linear patterns.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 40 degrees, tapering to a sharp vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along both lobes. Notable deep pixel-amplitude drop (indentation) located on the distal right lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve meeting at the median notch, with convex leading edges tapering toward blunt distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular yellow-white pixel clusters (likely barnacle attachments) visible on the left high-intensity patch and along the bottom-right fluke margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of parallel and unaligned dark linear marks (rake marks) localized within the high-intensity white patches on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant semi-circular notch or excision on the distal edge of the right lobe; vertical parallel rake marks visible on the lower right lobe near the water line.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly complex, marble-like black pigmentation pattern within the white fields, resembling brush-stroke textures.
